text:
Maya: Quick idea — who wants to do the parkrun on Thursday? Meet in the lobby at 6:50am, start at 7. Short 5K loop around the park.
Jon: I'm in if there's coffee after :coffee:
Sophie: Count me in, can we put a marker flag so it's easy to find the group?
Frank: 6:50 is tight for me, could I meet on the route at 7:05?
Maya: @Frank yep! we'll do a quick check-in in the lobby then two smaller groups, no worries.
Leo: Might be late — doing a client call. If I bail, save me a Strava tag? :sweat_smile:
Strava Bot: New challenge posted: "Redwood Thurs 5K - Lobby Run". Join the group: https://strava.com/segments/1234567
Sophie: Also low-key poll — do people want an easy pace or a tempo run?
Maya: Easy pace, this one's social + donuts after (optional) :donut:
Jon: Donuts sealed the deal :tada:
Frank: Ok I'll aim for the lobby at 6:50, see you all there.
Leo: If I'm late I'll meet you by the fountain at 7:03.
Maya: Awesome — final note: bring a reflective vest if you have one, route has one dark stretch. See you Thursday! :running:
